issues.message: Growth mechanic 'gain_stack_on_kill' capped to limited growth; unlimited growth not available in runtime_safe mode.
Effect blocks were empty; populated from registered modules based on attack_pattern and control_effect.
Media constraints enforced: single_subject, clean_background, no_enemy_in_sprite, no_attack_effect_on_body_sprite.

applied_fixes.description: Capped growth from unlimited to limited for runtime_safe mode.
Populated effect_blocks from registered module registry based on attack_pattern and control_effect.
Applied media constraints from visual.constraints to media_constraints.
